overview: The commission approved chimney repairs for 309 High Street and began reviewing draft design guidelines for the city's historic districts. The meeting also addressed aesthetic standards for solar panel installations and outreach strategies for the proposed South Street district.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the meeting held on January 12.

items.title: 309 High Street Chimney Repair
items.summary: Approved an application by owner Ben Coy to rebuild two chimneys in bare brick to match previous repairs and install a low-profile damper.

items.title: Solar Energy in Historic Districts
items.summary: Discussed the aesthetic impact of solar panels on historic properties and the potential suitability of solar shingles for preserving district character.

items.title: Historic District Design Guidelines
items.summary: Reviewed a draft of comprehensive design guidelines intended to balance historic preservation with modern materials and energy efficiency upgrades.

items.title: South Street District Planning
items.summary: Scheduled a site walkthrough for the week of February 20 and reviewed community outreach materials for property owners within the proposed district.
